name: DEV Community

sources.title: DEV Community FAQ/nav — 'Create account', organizations, code of conduct
DEV Community homepage — software-development community built on open-source Forem

requirements: A DEV account (create via dev.to/enter or the 'Create account' button; GitHub/email sign-in)
Content should be relevant to software development; posts are governed by the Code of Conduct and Terms of Use
For a company presence, Organization Accounts exist at dev.to/organizations
preparation: A substantive launch/technical post — e.g., 'how we built X' performs far better than pure promotion
Decide individual post vs Organization account for ongoing product content
workflow: Fill the profile (name, bio, website link — the profile itself is a durable backlink surface)
Write a post at dev.to/new: title, markdown body, tags, cover image; include the product link with context
Publish and confirm the post renders publicly at dev.to/<user>/<slug>
Optionally create an Organization to publish under the product's brand
watchFor: DEV is a community, not a directory — thin 'check out my tool' posts get flagged/downweighted; lead with the technical story
Canonical URL field exists for syndicated posts — use it to avoid duplicate-content issues
DEV++ is a paid membership tier; it is not required for posting
All content on dev.to; outbound links' follow status is not documented on fetched pages
countsAsLive: The post is publicly reachable at dev.to/<username>/<slug> and your profile page shows the website link to logged-out visitors
unknowns: Whether post/profile outbound links are dofollow
Any new-account throttling (post frequency limits) not shown on public pages
